R7AD-grouse-drive-0001.name: By Dave Henry Creek
R7AD-grouse-drive-0001.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).
R7AD-grouse-drive-0001.parkWhat: pull off on E Canoe FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: Road: E Canoe FSR, 5.4 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
4 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
3 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 7A table (page 57), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). MU 7-1 is listed in Region 7A on page 2 but no row names it.

plan: Drive: from Village of Valemount, about 19 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Whiskeyfill Rd, Bailey Rd, Canoe Rd, E Canoe FSR.
Park: 52.7445, -119.09599, pull off on E Canoe FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the E Canoe FSR stretch, 5.4 km one way. About 109 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
